rule: Holdout membership is frozen by project fingerprint, NOT by position in a sorted list. Adding or removing a project must never change which projects are held out.
fingerprint: sha256(project path as reported by the dump's `project` field), first 16 hex chars. One-way: the real path is not recoverable from this file, so the snapshot is safe to commit while the path->fingerprint mapping stays in untracked scratch.
note: These two fingerprints are exactly the projects that the original 2026-07-22 index-based rule (sorted anonymized ids, indices 1 and 4) selected against the corpus as it stood at freeze time. Recording them by fingerprint preserves that membership permanently. scripts/validity_sweep.py fails closed if any of these is absent from the discovered corpus.
